purpose: Distinguish an observer race from a real process-lifecycle defect after the pinned Fairy comparator emitted its fatal missing-network message but remained observable for 120 seconds in lease 265.

fatal_markers: info string ERROR: If the UCI option "Use NNUE" is set to true, network evaluation parameters compatible with the engine must be available.
info string ERROR: The engine will be terminated now.

cleanup: If a diagnostic engine remains alive after the final sample, terminate only that exact child PID and record forced_cleanup=true.

classifications.OBSERVER_RACE_NOT_REPRODUCED: Both go cases exit nonzero spontaneously before the final sample.
classifications.REPRODUCED_GO_WORKER_NONTERMINATION: Both go cases remain alive through 10 seconds after the fatal marker while the normal control exits cleanly.
classifications.THREAD_CONTEXT_DIFFERENTIAL: The eval case exits nonzero spontaneously but both go cases remain alive through 10 seconds.

interpretation: This diagnostic can classify process lifecycle only. It cannot qualify the comparator, repair fail-closed behavior, admit a match, measure speed or claim strength.
stopping_rule: Execute these four fresh processes once in namespace 266. Preserve every log and sample. Do not extend the wait, add repetitions or change commands after observing the outcome.
